fonts.display: 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Fraunces', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Lime Sprint
palette.role: Green action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments.

palette.name: Paper White
palette.role: Primary page canvas and inverse text on dark surfaces

palette.name: Cream
palette.role: Warm off-white surface for cards, stat tiles, and footer — a barely-there yellow-green tint that distinguishes a lifted surface from the page without introducing a new color

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: Primary text color, default border, icon stroke, and hard shadow color. This is the single dark token that does structural work across text, lines, and elevation

palette.name: Black Ink
palette.role: Strongest display text and filled icon glyphs where maximum weight is needed inside a headline or pull-quote

palette.name: Depth
palette.role: Dark button and surface background — used for the large primary action blocks in the nav and hero where a heavier fill than ink is needed but true black would be too harsh

palette.name: Rule
palette.role: Hairline borders, card outlines, footer dividers, and the soft separator between sections

palette.name: Muted
palette.role: Secondary body text, supporting descriptions, and the slightly softer voice below a heading

palette.name: Muted Gray
palette.role: Tertiary helper text, badge labels, copyright fine print, and the most de-emphasized text in the hierarchy

palette.name: Mint Edge
palette.role: Green accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis

palette.name: Mint Wash
palette.role: Gray action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments
